name: naf4_shannon_diversity
formula_description: Shannon entropy: -Σ p_i × ln(p_i) over NAF4 codes present in ZE2020
aggregation_to_ze2020: Shannon entropy of NAF4 distribution per ZE2020
leakage_reason: NAF4 distribution derived from SIRENE stock (T-1 lag). Static version from 2022 snapshot only safe for 2022+.
expected_metric: Higher diversity → lower volatility in total establishment creation
acceptance_criterion: WMAPE improvement ≥0.2pp in small/medium ZEs OR seed variance reduced. No degradation in 2021.

name: naf4_hhi
aggregation_to_ze2020: HHI of NAF4 distribution per ZE2020
acceptance_criterion: HHI and diversity should be negatively correlated. If HHI > 0.5, ZE more volatile.

name: top_naf4_share
formula_description: Share of establishments in dominant NAF4 sector per ZE2020
leakage_reason: Static snapshot 2022. For backtest ≤2021: reconstruct from util_histo_establishment (available 2006–2018 at dept level, not commune).
expected_metric: Very high top-naf4-share ZEs may show sector-specific shocks
acceptance_criterion: If top_naf4_share > 0.4: ZE considered concentrated. Check WMAPE in concentrated vs. diversified zones.

name: n_distinct_naf4
formula_description: Count of distinct NAF4 codes present in ZE2020
expected_metric: More NAF4 codes → more diverse economy
acceptance_criterion: Correlation with n_active_estab expected (larger ZE = more NAF4). Normalize by log(n_estab).

name: mean_naf_proximity
formula_description: Mean pairwise NAF proximity score between co-present NAF codes in ZE2020
aggregation_to_ze2020: Mean proximity for all co-present NAF pairs within ZE2020
leakage_reason: vw_naf_proximity matrix is static. Sector presence changes annually (use T-1 SIRENE for dynamic version).
expected_metric: ZEs with more complementary sectors may show more stable growth
acceptance_criterion: Mean NAF proximity > 0.5 indicates cohesive productive tissue. Expect lower WMAPE variance.

name: mean_semantic_proximity
formula_description: Mean pairwise semantic NAF proximity within ZE2020
aggregation_to_ze2020: Mean semantic proximity for co-present NAF pairs per ZE2020
expected_metric: Semantic proximity captures labor market coherence beyond product space
acceptance_criterion: Semantic vs. product-space proximity may capture different dimensions.

name: nace_io_linkage_strength
formula_description: Sum of IO coefficients: Σ io_coeff(i,j) for sector pairs (i,j) both present in ZE2020
aggregation_to_ze2020: Weighted sum of IO linkages for sectors co-present in ZE2020
leakage_reason: IO table is structural benchmark (2015 or 2019 vintage). Sector presence uses T-1 SIRENE for dynamic version.
expected_metric: ZEs with strong IO linkages (supply chains) show more resilient creation dynamics
acceptance_criterion: IO linkage strength > 1.0 (arbitrary threshold): test if these ZEs have lower WMAPE in sector C (industry).

name: supplier_density
formula_description: Count of potential supplier sectors present in ZE2020 per NACE sector
aggregation_to_ze2020: Count of distinct supplier NACE sectors per ZE2020
leakage_reason: partner_calc_iot is a 2022 static snapshot. Not safe as training feature without temporal reconstruction. Valid as post-model layer.
expected_metric: ZEs with diverse supplier base may attract more new establishments
acceptance_criterion: Use after HERALD prediction to explain which supply chain factors correlate with predicted growth.

name: avg_product_complexity_pci
formula_description: Mean PCI (Product Complexity Index) of HS4 products declared by establishments in ZE2020
leakage_reason: PCI vintage ≤2018 (Harvard Atlas). Safe for all HERALD years. PCI is structural.
expected_metric: Higher mean PCI → more complex productive base → potentially more stable or higher-growth trajectory
acceptance_criterion: PCI quartile analysis: do high-PCI ZEs have lower WMAPE or higher growth? Expect difference in A10-C (industry) sectors.

name: pci_std_within_ze
formula_description: Standard deviation of PCI across products in ZE2020
aggregation_to_ze2020: Std dev of PCI per ZE2020
expected_metric: High PCI variance = diverse product sophistication mix
acceptance_criterion: High PCI_std may indicate transition zones (mixed sophistication).

name: avg_green_score
formula_description: Mean green production score of HS4 products declared by establishments in ZE2020
leakage_reason: green_norm source not confirmed. Use only as post-model layer until source validated.
expected_metric: ZEs with higher green score may be targets for green transition policy
acceptance_criterion: Post-model: after HERALD predicts growth, identify ZEs with high green potential for targeted recommendations.

name: avg_resilience_score
formula_description: Mean productive resilience score of HS4 products per ZE2020
leakage_reason: resilience_norm methodology: network efficiency × redundancy from trade flows 2019. Structural indicator.
expected_metric: Higher resilience score → ZE produces more shock-resistant products
acceptance_criterion: Test correlation with WMAPE 2021 (COVID shock year). High resilience ZEs may have had lower 2021 impact.

name: maslow_coverage
formula_description: Mean Maslow basic necessity score of products in ZE2020
leakage_reason: maslow_norm source confirmed (Maslow hierarchy applied to HS4). Post-model only: context layer.
expected_metric: ZEs producing basic necessities may have more stable demand regardless of economic cycle
acceptance_criterion: Post-model interpretation: explain why some ZEs show counter-cyclical patterns.

name: recommendation_density
formula_description: Count of computed recommendations per active establishment in ZE2020
leakage_reason: Static 2022 snapshot of computed recommendations. Do NOT use for any backtest. Valid for 2022+ post-model only.
expected_metric: ZEs with high recommendation density may have more dynamic partnership networks
acceptance_criterion: Post-model: overlay HERALD prediction with recommendation density to generate targeted partnership suggestions.

name: partner_potential_mean
formula_description: Mean partner score from ia_establishment_potential_partners, aggregated by ZE2020
expected_metric: Average partnership potential score represents economic integration capacity of ZE
acceptance_criterion: Post-model enrichment: link predicted high-growth ZEs to their highest-potential partnerships.

name: workforce_density
formula_description: Total workforce per km² proxy (total_workforce / n_communes in ZE2020 as proxy)
leakage_reason: workforce_count from 2020-2022 SIRENE snapshot. For backtest ≤2019: reconstruct from CLAP/DARES employment data (T-2 lag).
expected_metric: Higher workforce density may indicate agglomeration economies → positive establishment creation dynamics
acceptance_criterion: Correlation with n_active_estab expected. Normalize properly. Test in A10-G (trade) and A10-I (hospitality).
